tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Cool, airy off-white; never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, list groups, the tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inputs, segmented-control track, Missing badge fill, table header cells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, toggle-off and secondary-button borders (≥3:1 on surface-1 and surface-0 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0, surface-1, surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, reasons, help text, captions, on surface-0/1/2 (≥4.5:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Indigo. Primary buttons, links, active tab, toggles on, Met and Verified badges, 'Ready to decide'.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed state.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Met badge fill, selected option fill, Ready summary card. Text on it is accent.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Amber for Needs review, Mismatch, legal warnings and timers. Text/icons on surface-1, warn-soft.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of Issues card, warning banners, Needs review and Mismatch badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Crimson. ONLY for Not met and destructive actions (Delete, Deny button outline).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (destructive confirm button).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Not met badge fill. Text on it is danger.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every focusable control (≥3:1 on all surfaces).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets and dialogs.

families.sans: Inter, -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Pick tenants the same way, every time.
styles.usage: Onboarding headlines and large screen titles (Rentals, Guide, Settings).

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen header of a Rental or Applicant.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Card and sheet titles, section headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Set your criteria once. Check every applicant against them.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names in lists, criterion names, button labels.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Status badges only. Always paired with an icon.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Ratios and money in summaries. Use with tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between badges, chip groups, small stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding (vertical), gap inside cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty-state and onboarding vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges' inner icon box, table cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, segmented control, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, timers, toggles.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target in both axes.

tokens.name: button-primary-h
tokens.usage: Height of primary buttons.

tokens.name: button-secondary-h
tokens.usage: Height of secondary and destructive buttons.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height (plus safe area).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width on tablets.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on surface-0. Dark theme relies on surface-1 vs surface-0 instead.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and dialogs.
